start: Members, then Import; an Excel file with names, mobiles, plans, fees and valid-till dates

steps.action: Open 'Import members from Excel'
user_sees: Card 'Your file' with four lines, the last: 'Nothing is saved until you check the list and tap Add.'
Buttons 'Choose file' and 'Download sample file'
must_not: Anything saved before Add is tapped

steps.action: Tap 'Choose file' and pick the .xlsx
user_sees: 'Reading the file… a big sheet can take a few seconds.'
Card 'Which column is which': '<file name>. We matched them from the column names and what is in them. Change any that are wrong.'
Name and Mobile boxes marked with ' *'
must_not: A column matched to two boxes at once

steps.action: Read 'Check the list' and 'Plans and payments'
user_sees: '<n> rows: <n> will be added, <n> already members or repeated, <n> with a problem.'
Chips 'All', 'Will be added', 'Already members', 'Problems'
'<n> members come with their plan and its dates (<n> plan names), and ₹<amount> already paid as receipts. Expiry reminders work for them from day one.'
must_not: Counts that do not add up to the number of rows
The paid money added up twice

steps.action: Tap 'Add <n> members'
user_sees: 'Adding members…'
'<done> of <total> done. Keep this page open until it finishes.'
The '← Members' button is gone while it runs
must_not: A second run started by a second tap

steps.action: Wait for it to finish
user_sees: 'Import finished'
'<n> added, <n> skipped'
'<n> plans with their dates · <n> receipts'
Buttons 'Open members' and 'Import another file'
Card 'Past imports' with this import
must_not: A member added twice
A payment saved twice

start: A file where some mobiles are already members (another kind: fill in blank details)

steps.action: Choose the file and read 'Check the list'
user_sees: '<n> are already members of your gym (same mobile). For them:'
Chips 'Skip them' and 'Fill in their blank details'
must_not: An existing member counted under Will be added

steps.action: Tap 'Fill in their blank details'
user_sees: 'Only empty details are filled in. Their name, mobile and joining date stay as they are.'
The main button reads 'Add <n> members, update <n>' or 'Update <n> members'
must_not: A detail that already has a value changed

steps.action: Tap the main button and wait
user_sees: '<n> added, <n> skipped, <n> filled in'
must_not: An existing member's name, mobile or joining date overwritten

start: An Excel file with three sheets (another kind of file)

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: A 'Sheet' box; the line names the sheet and '(it looks most like a member list)'
Each sheet listed as '<name> (<n> rows)'
must_not: An empty or totals sheet picked first

steps.action: Add the members of the first sheet
user_sees: 'Import finished' with a button 'Import the next sheet: “<name>”'
must_not: Fixes typed for the first sheet applied to the next one

steps.action: Tap the next-sheet button
user_sees: The next sheet's columns and list; in the Sheet box the first sheet is marked '· added'
must_not: The same sheet offered again as not added

start: Import page (other things to tap: the sample file and the skipped rows)

steps.action: Tap 'Download sample file'
user_sees: A CSV file with members sample in its name is saved
must_not: A file that the import itself cannot read back

steps.action: Import a file where some rows are skipped
user_sees: 'Download the skipped rows and fix them in Excel. The reason is in the first column. Then import that file.'
Button 'Download <n> skipped rows'
must_not: Skipped rows that cannot be found anywhere after the import

steps.action: Tap the download button
user_sees: A CSV named skipped rows plus the file name, with the reason in the first column
must_not: An empty file
Aadhaar or PAN numbers in it

steps.action: Choose a file bigger than 5 MB
user_sees: Red banner 'That file is over 5 MB. It is too big for a member list. Pick the Excel or CSV file with your members.'
must_not: The page freezing while it tries to read the file

steps.action: Choose a PDF or a picture
user_sees: 'That is not an Excel or CSV file. Pick a .xlsx, .xls or .csv file.'
must_not: A list of nonsense rows offered for import

steps.action: Choose a sheet with only column names
user_sees: 'That file has no member rows. It needs one row of column names, then one row per member.'
must_not: An Add button for zero rows

steps.action: Choose a good file, then set the Name and Mobile boxes to — Not in the file —
user_sees: Red banner 'Pick the columns with the name and the mobile number.'
The Add button is greyed
must_not: Members added with no name or no mobile

steps.action: Choose a file with more rows than the limit
user_sees: 'Only the first <limit> rows can be imported at once. <n> more rows were left out. Import them as a second file.'
must_not: Rows past the limit dropped without a word

start: A file with a few bad rows

steps.action: Choose a file where some rows have a wrong mobile; scroll to 'Rows to check'
user_sees: Card 'Rows to check' with each row and its reason
Boxes to fix the name, mobile or joining date
must_not: A problem row dropped without being named

steps.action: Type the right mobile for one row and tap the check button; skip another row
user_sees: 'Row <n> checked again.'
The fixed row moves to Will be added; the skipped row leaves the card
must_not: The typed fix lost when another row is fixed
The skipped row added anyway

steps.action: Tap the Add button; the internet drops halfway
user_sees: 'Saving stopped halfway: <reason> <n> members were saved (up to row <n>). The rest may not be saved. When the internet is back, tap “Try again” below, or import the same file again. Members already added are skipped, so nobody is added twice.'
'<n> rows are not saved yet. Tap “Try again” to send just these rows.'
must_not: 'Import finished' with no word about the rows that are not saved

steps.action: Turn the internet on and tap 'Try again'
user_sees: 'Adding members…' and then the counts with the waiting rows now added
must_not: A member added twice
A second entry in Past imports for the same file

start: A file from old gym software with ID numbers in it

steps.action: Choose a file that has an Aadhaar column and a PAN number typed inside a notes column
user_sees: 'Not imported: <column> has Aadhaar numbers. ID numbers are never imported.'
'<column> is read as usual. Any Aadhaar or PAN number in it is left out.'
On the first card: 'Aadhaar and PAN numbers are never imported.'
must_not: An Aadhaar or PAN number saved in a member note or extra detail

steps.action: Look at 'Other columns in your file' and add the members
user_sees: Only ticked columns are kept as extra details on the member page
must_not: An unticked column saved
An ID number in the downloaded skipped-rows file

start: Front desk signed in; a file with names and mobiles only

steps.action: Open 'Import members from Excel'
user_sees: Card 'Your file' and the buttons 'Choose file' and 'Download sample file'
must_not: A 'Past imports' card for the front desk

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: 'Which column is which' and 'Check the list' with the counts
must_not: A line about AI matching (it is for the owner only)

steps.action: Tap 'Add <n> members' and wait
user_sees: 'Adding members…'
'Import finished', '<n> added, <n> skipped'
Button 'Open members'
must_not: A member added twice

start: Front desk signed in; a file that also has plans and fees (another kind of file)

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: Card 'Plans and payments': '<n> members have a plan in this file. Only the owner can add plans and payments. Members are added now. Plans are added when the owner imports the same file.'
must_not: A money total shown to the front desk

steps.action: Tap the Add button and wait
user_sees: 'Only the owner can add the plans and payments in this file. Ask the owner to import the same file. Members already added are skipped.'
must_not: A membership or a receipt saved by the front desk

steps.action: The owner imports the same file later
user_sees: The main button reads 'Add <n> plans and payments'
must_not: The members added a second time
